about: X.P.W9 .vc9 — the file-level rulings of the 2026-11-04 census (census-2026-11-04.json): every css-variables-1 / css-syntax-3 file at the pin that V-C does not extract, with the harness it calls and why it carries no specified-value case. A census file that is neither extracted nor ruled fails V-C (UNRULED FILE); a ruled file that is extracted fails it too (STALE FILE).
